notes: two sayings: Abu Sa'id's own «الدرهم بالدرهم» (saying 1) and the Prophet's «إنما الربا في النسيئة» that Ibn Abbas gives on Usama's word (saying 2, rule 4a); the second group shares the head and writes the names again
Abu Sa'id speaks in the story (he went to Ibn Abbas and asked); Ibn Abbas answers and is a link (rule 6); «ابن عباس» occurrence 1 is the reference to hearing him, occurrence 2 the meeting
Usama is the last link; the Prophet is the end
